properties.description:

waterways.

locations near the waterfront and shoreline resulting in a low

unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued October 22 at 2:58PM MST until October 22 at 4:00PM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
SVRPSR

The National Weather Service in Phoenix has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Gila County in east central Arizona...

* Until 400 PM MST.

* At 258 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm was located 17 miles southeast
of Sawmill, or 34 miles east of Globe, moving northeast at 40 mph.

HAZARD...Ping pong ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect
wind damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Sawmill and Hilltop.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds and large
hail.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Lightning is one of nature's leading killers. Remember, if you can
hear thunder, you are close enough to be struck by lightning.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

A Tornado Watch remains in effect until 800 PM MST Thursday for a
portion of east central Arizona.

properties.description:

* Dust Advisory for...
Northeastern Kings County in central California...
Southwestern Tulare County in central California...

* Until 400 PM PDT.

* At 254 PM PDT, Blowing dust were located along a line from over
Lemoore to 14 miles south of Corcoran, or along a line from 6 miles
west of Hanford to 15 miles northwest of Delano, moving northeast
at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Less than three miles visibility with strong winds in
excess of 40 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hazardous travel.

* Locations impacted include...
Tulare, Hanford, Corcoran, Lemoore, Home Garden, Armona, Alpaugh
and Allensworth State Park.
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not drive into an area of blowing dust. PULL ASIDE
STAY ALIVE!

Blowing dust brings reduced visibility, leading to dangerous driving
conditions. If driving, avoid blowing dust if possible. If caught in
dense blowing dust, pull off the road, turn off your lights and keep
your foot off the brake.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 22 at 3:41PM MDT until October 22 at 6:45PM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
West Central Kane County in southern Utah...
East Central Washington County in southwestern Utah...

* Until 645 PM MDT.

* At 341 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms moving into
Zion National Park from the south. Up to 0.25 inches of rain have
fallen from previous showers over the last half hour. Additional
rainfall amounts up to 0.75 inches are possible across the park as
these thunderstorms move in. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of slot canyons, normally
dry washes, creeks and streams

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Zion National Park and Springdale.
properties.instruction:
Move to higher ground now. Act quickly to protect your life.

Stay away or be swept away. River banks and culverts can become
unstable and unsafe.

Flooding is occurring or is imminent. It is important to know where
you are relative to slot canyons, normally dry washes, creeks and
streams which can become killers in heavy rains. Campers and hikers
should avoid streams or creeks.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 6:45 PM MDT. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 6:45 PM MDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.
